HRA Analysis: MOSTERT (9) was able to zip across early last time out and hold off Fate Awaits late who had the perfect run on his back. He should get an economical run through early and can be put into the race at some stage. BAINBRIDGE (7) did things wrong at the start last time out and was out of play in the early stages there. He did impress his start prior when leading and being run down by the in-form Smarter Than You. FOR REAL LIFE (8) was able to secure a good run behind Leap To Fame and ran into a strong there when first up from a spell there. He looks set to get a good run behind the speed again in this race and can be running on late. TREMENDOUS SENSATION (10) should get a good run off the speed in this race from a soft trailing draw. She hasn’t been suited by draws in recent outings and should be more suited in this race. SELECTIONS: MOSTERT (9), BAINBRIDGE (7), FOR REAL LIFE (8), TREMENDOUS SENSATION (10) SUGGESTED BET: BAINBRIDGE (7) to win.

DASHING (6) burned around them while they were running last time out and was able to get in behind Leap To Fame and run an impressive second there. He may be able to zip across and lead in this race and looks likely to be very hard to run down. SMARTER THAN YOU (1) has good gate speed and should be able to drive through and lead before having options from there. He has been incredibly impressive this campaign and ran a great third behind Leap To Fame two starts ago before having less go his way last time out. TIMS A TROOPER (8) should get a good run through in this race and will settle close enough on the pegs in this race. He was forced to sit without cover last time out and battled on reasonably for fifth given he is usually best when sat up and saved for one run. WISPER A SECRET (9) burned hard last time out and wasn’t quite able to get across but was able to get in behind the leader eventually but had just done too much work in the early stages. He should get a good run behind the speed and can be running on late. SELECTIONS: DASHING (6), SMARTER THAN YOU (1), TIMS A TROOPER (8), WISPER A SECRET (9) SUGGESTED BET: SMARTER THAN YOU (1) to place.

MOVE IT LOU (4) did a few things wrong last time in. He ran well in a recent trial finishing second to Sinabun. He looks to be the best drawn of the main chances in this race and should be very hard to run down if he’s able to find the front early. SHADES OF MIKI (7) was running on strongly late last time out into third behind very smart horse Always B Cool. He has shown he is capable of doing work in his races and can look to press forward and race in a prominent position in this race. WAIKAKA MAGIC (6) trialled up nicely recently finishing third in good time behind Sinabun who has since run well since returning from a spell. He should be able to secure a good run off the speed in this race and can be running on late. SKIP TO ME LOU (3) was forced to race without cover last time out and proved too good for Claudes Desire. He should be able to find a prominent position in this race and should run well from there. SELECTIONS: MOVE IT LOU (4), SHADES OF MIKI (7), WAIKAKA MAGIC (6), SKIP TO ME LOU (3) SUGGESTED BET: MOVE IT LOU (4) to win.

GOLDEN SUNSET (6) was incredibly impressive last time out when sitting without cover and running by key rival in this race KEAYANG STUKA (3) despite the tough run. She draws wide in this race but has shown she is capable of doing work in her races and she should be hard to beat again. KEAYANG STUKA (3) was able to find the front from the mobile three starts ago and couldn’t hold off the challenge of GOLDEN SUNET (6). He has since run well twice in stand starts and should run well again in this race from a good draw. ALDERBARAN STILINSKI (5) trialled up nicely finishing fourth behind Alwaysbjoy. He is a trotter with very good ability and his manners at times have let him down at various stages through his career. PINNIE (9) ran another very good race last time out finishing second to her star stablemate Gus in track record time at this track. She should get a good run through in this race and can be running on late. SELECTIONS: GOLDEN SUNSET (6), KEAYANG STUKA (3), ALDERBARAN STILINSKI (5), PINNIE (9) SUGGESTED BET: GOLDEN SUNSET (6) to win.

SPUNKYS GOTSECRETS (4) led last time out after showing good gate speed to lead early there and was run down late in fast time by Greased Lightnin and Dragon. He can lead again and should be hard to run down this time. BETTOR CHEER (1) should be able to drive through and repel the likely early challenge of Sweet Lad Jujon who is directly alongside him before handing over to one of the better chance. He was able to secure a similar run last time out and ran on late into third. BLACKJACK CRIPPA (9) should get a good run off the speed in this race from a soft trailing draw. He raced off the peg last time out and was excellent there running fourth in a race taken out by Greased Lightnin. He should be running on again. STARZZZ DESTINY (5) was beaten a very long way last time out when not suited to sitting without cover in that level of race which was taken out by Greased Lightnin. He may look to find a more economical run from a wide draw and will need some luck in running. SELECTIONS: SPUNKYS GOTSECRETS (4), BETTOR CHEER (1), BLACKJACK CRIPPA (9), STARZZZ DESTINY (5) SUGGESTED BET: SPUNKYS GOTSECRETS (4) to win.

WILLIAMS (4) should be able to work forward in the early stages of this race and find the front. He was very impressive two starts ago racing without cover and battling on for second behind stablemate Mostert. He backed that up with a good all the way win last time out and appears to find another suitable race. GLENEAGLE VEE CEE (1) has excellent gate speed and should be able to drive through and lead before handing over. He was shuffled back last time out and not beaten too far there in a race taken out by smart horse Mostert. BETTORS MOON (8) should get a good run through in this race to settle close enough on the pegs which should somewhat offset the clear rise in grade for this mare. She was running on nicely late last time out after sitting behind the leader. TARGARYEN (7) has an awkward draw in this race and looks likely to be shuffled back early in this race. He was forced to race without cover last time out and battled away well there for fifth behind Mostert. SELECTIONS: WILLIAMS (4), GLENEAGLE VEE CEE (1), BETTORS MOON (8), TARGARYEN (7) SUGGESTED BET: GLENEAGLE VEE CEE (1) to place.

OUR ULTIMATE JESSY (1) has reasonable gate speed and should be able to drive through and lead in the early stage of this race from a good draw. She was forced to race without cover last time out and battled on well there for third behind The Lady Dior. She should be hard to run down. PRINCESS ARNA (8) should get a good run through in the early stages of this race behind a gate speed horse in Our Ultimate Jessy. She secured a similar run behind the leader five starts ago and just came up a touch short behind Dove Lake. DOLLY ROCKET (3) secured a good run on the pegs two starts ago and was flashing home late into second behind Tizzy Lizzie. She may be shuffled back this time and if the race is run to suit she should be running on late. ROSTOVA (9) comes into this race third up from a spell and should be nearing peak fitness in this race. She should be able to tuck in behind the speed which is how she is seemingly best suited in her races and should be running on well late. SELECTIONS: OUR ULTIMATE JESSY (1), PRINCESS ARNA (8), DOLLY ROCKET (3), ROSTOVA (9) SUGGESTED BET: OUR ULTIMATE JESSY (1) to win.

FIRE AND PASSION (5) was forced to sit without cover last time out at this track when applying strong pressure before racing to the lead and coring very impressively in fast time. This race looks no tougher than his latest outing and he should be very hard to beat again. JAMES ALFRED (2) has led in races previously but does appear to be a horse better suited when driven with a sit. He should get a good run from a favourable draw and won’t be far away. MY ULTIMATE ZANDER (1) draws ideally in this race and should settle in a prominent position early in this race. He secured a good run behind the speed last time out and was running on late into third behind stablemate Fire And Passion. BITE THE EAR MIKE (3) was running on late last time out into second behind FIRE AND PASSION (5). He should settle close in the small field and should be thereabouts again in what looks to be a very similar race. SELECTIONS: FIRE AND PASSION (5), JAMES ALFRED (2), MY ULTIMATE ZANDER (1), BITE THE EAR MIKE (3) SUGGESTED BET: FIRE AND PASSION (5) to win. OVERVIEW:COLLEAGUES (7) has gait issues but he appears to be hard to beat against this class if he delivers a fool proof display. He was going to finish in second at Maryborough last week but broke stride at the 100m mark and ended up being placed in fifth. OLIVER SMUDGE (5) hasn’t raced since May 2023 but he was a runaway trial winner at Maryborough last week. He is nicely bred and strikes a suitable assignment for his first up performance so he cannot be underestimated. SOME DAYS WE DREAM (1) is resuming since December and hasn’t been to the trials but she is worth thought from the pole position. LITTLER (2) is ideally drawn and is capable of filling a place. SELECTIONS: COLLEAGUES (7), OLIVER SMUDGE (5), SOME DAYS WE DREAM (1), LITTLER (2)

OVERVIEW:PIRANI PERFECT (4) has been placed in both of her starts since transferring to trainer Rebecca Bartley and met a stronger field when second behind Crackin Philtra in a slick mile rate of 1.56.0 at Kilmore last outing. She possesses early speed and gets her chance to break through for a win. MAJOR LINCOLN (7) was slow away and settled a clear last early when fifth at Swan Hill last outing. He was placed at his five attempts prior and should be hitting the line strongly. ROJENBYE (3) performs well at Charlton having been placed in four of his six starts (2 wins) to date. He is better drawn than his recent performances and gets his chance to improve on his numerical form. PRESIDENTIALCHANGE (6) disappointed at Hamilton last week but he is a fast beginner and this race is easier so he can show improvement. BACK: PIRANI PERFECT (4) – 1.5 units (each way) SELECTIONS: PIRANI PERFECT (4), MAJOR LINCOLN (7), ROJENBYE (3), PRESIDENTIALCHANGE (6)

OVERVIEW: LOU EASYANA (8) should be getting fitter after having two starts back from a spell and finished very nicely when second behind Huxham Chubb at Hamilton last week. This race appears to be easier so she is a good chance of going one better now. TOTALLY STUNNING (7) has returned from a spell in good form having been placed in all of her four attempts and looms as one of the leading chances again. She finished quickly to win at Shepparton on September 15 and finished off well for third in a slick mile rate of 1.53.9 at Wagga last outing. HUNGRY HOGARTH (3) settled midfield, raced fiercely and finished off solidly for a close second at Swan Hill last outing. This race is no harder and he should be competitive again. LEONARD (6) sustained a flat tyre when in the leading role and had excuses last outing. He led throughout at a recent Swan Hill victory and is worth another chance. BACK: LOU EASYANA (8) – 1.5 units (each way) SELECTIONS: LOU EASYANA (8), TOTALLY STUNNING (7), HUNGRY HOGARTH (3), LEONARD (6)

OVERVIEW: ICANMOTOR (7) has had several chances since his latest victory but he was placed three times in succession against similar grade back in October and should run a good race again despite the wide draw. DANCIN WITH ELVIS (2) is a fast beginner and gets his chance to improve on his recent efforts. He met a stronger field at Hamilton on October 26 and is backing up quickly from his effort at Mount Gambier on Friday night. GO GEORGE GO (4) is a grinding type that finished third from behind the leader at his latest appearance. He has had four starts on the track for a win and a third and is worth thought under these conditions. MY LUCKY ROCK (1) has been safely held at her two starts back from a break but she should be getting fitter and her form last preparation would suggest she can be competitive against this line up. SELECTIONS: ICANMOTOR (7), DANCIN WITH ELVIS (2), GO GEORGE GO (4), MY LUCKY ROCK (1)

OVERVIEW:SPORTS WRACK (4) hasn’t won a race in 19 starts for the season but this is his easiest assignment for a long time and he has the early speed to give a forward showing. He settled midfield on the markers when sixth behind Krissy at Kilmore last outing. JAMES GARNER (8) is resuming since a fourth at Ararat in March and hasn’t been to the trials but he would go close if he is somewhere near his peak. NO EMOTION (2) will appreciate a slight drop back in class and wasn’t beaten by far at his latest Charlton appearance behind Eyesealittle and Huxham Chubb (won twice since). He is drawn to run a good race. OUTBACK QUEENIE (9) has performed below her best since resuming but she appears to be better placed against this field and gets her chance to improve. SELECTIONS: SPORTS WRACK (4), JAMES GARNER (8), NO EMOTION (2), OUTBACK QUEENIE (9)

OVERVIEW: It is an open race with many winning chances. HALF AS TOUGH (11) settled midfield and came out three horses wide from the 600m when a creditable second behind the smart 2yo pacer Dispersion at Hamilton last week. He is poorly drawn but should be competitive again. IDEAL HIGH (7) followed HALF AS TOUGH (11) all of the way and held his own over the latter stages when third in the same race last week. He should continue to benefit from race experience and is worth an investment. ITS HYDROMATIC (6) has only been placed once in 21 starts but he was performing nicely at the trials prior to a fast finishing sixth when resuming at Kilmore so he gets his chance to improve. The former New South Wales pacer KELLYS COMMOTION (10) ran a reasonable race when third behind Millies Boy at her Victorian debut and is not without a chance. BACK: HALF AS TOUGH (11) – 1 unit (each way) SELECTIONS: HALF AS TOUGH (11), IDEAL HIGH (7), ITS HYDROMATIC (6), KELLYS COMMOTION (10)

OVERVIEW: MISSMALACHITE (4) continues to perform consistently having been placed in six of her past eight starts and missed out by a narrow margin at Ballarat last outing. She possesses early speed and should make her presence felt. LESTER (9) is resuming since May and hasn’t been to the trials but he should prove hard to beat if he is close to his peak. He has won a race at Charlton previously and gets into this race nicely with a concession claim. YANKEE GAMBLER (10) should be building on his fitness after having two starts back from a spell. He performs best when he is close to the speed so being drawn on the second line is a disadvantage but he does have the ability to test this field. SKADI (2) led throughout at a Swan Hill victory on September 08 and has claims along with ESPERANZA (1) and ZEUSS (5), which will appreciate a drop back in class for this assignment. SELECTIONS: MISSMALACHITE (4), LESTER (9), YANKEE GAMBLER (10), ZEUSS (5)

OVERVIEW: SAINT EYES (3) settled midfield and was held up for a run at a vital stage before finishing stoutly for second behind Snickers Express at Maryborough last outing. His two efforts since resuming have been sound and he is worth thought again. CONNIES PRESIDENT (8) has won two of his past four starts and looms as one of the leading chances again. He trailed the leader after commencing from the inside of the second line when he won at Horsham two starts ago then picked up ground from the second half of the field at Maryborough. WHY NOW (11) commenced from the tough handicap of 40m when third behind the in-form mare Keayang Minnesota at his latest performance so he is worth thought from the same mark against this slightly easier grade. ATABOY CHARLIE (4) has performed below his best form in two starts back from a break but he is a fast beginner and should be getting fitter so he is worth thought. SELECTIONS: SAINT EYES (3), CONNIES PRESIDENT (8), WHY NOW (11), ATABOY CHARLIE (4)

OVERVIEW: CAPTAIN MOONLIGHT (1) is a former New Zealander, which was performing well at the trials prior to a third in the West Wyalong Cup on his Australian debut, where he commenced from the second line and was driven aggressively to find the lead with two laps remaining. He appears to be ideally placed from the pole position and will take beating. MY MATE ACE (3) is stepping up in class but is racing at his peak form and is a chance of completing four straight victories. He trailed the leader and used the sprint lane when he defeated Tryx Vixen (won since) at Kilmore last outing. THE WISE GUY (2) was resuming since August 2025 when he worked home reasonably well for third behind Decode in a sizzling mile rate of 1.54.9. He should have benefited from that performance and is better drawn so he must be considered as a winning chance. RABADA (5) is resuming but was racing at Metropolitan level at his last campaign and has claims along with EMILY VINCENT (7) and MISTER JIMARINGLE (10), which bounced back to his best form with a win in a career best mile rate of 1.54.5 at Kilmore last outing. BACK: CAPTAIN MOONLIGHT (1) – 2 units (win) SELECTIONS: CAPTAIN MOONLIGHT (1), MY MATE ACE (3), THE WISE GUY (2), RABADA (5)

OVERVIEW: SURETHING (7) was resuming since a victory at Mildura in June when she attempted to lead early, was stranded without cover and eased back to the markers to settle three back at her latest creditable second. She should be fitter from that performance and is capable of overcoming the poor draw. ROCKAMARA (8) has only been successful once in 13 attempts but that victory was at Melton over Sheer Me (won twice since) and the mile rate was a quick 1.55.7. Her recent efforts have been in South Australia and she must be considered as a winning chance on her Victorian return. BUBBLE OVER (9) was resuming since May when third behind the smart pacer Colosimo at Terang. She should be fitter from that run and is worth following. PHILS BOY (5) beaten the easier Maiden class at Mildura last outing but he won easily and has improved with every start to date. He is worth thought along with JANSEN (10), which was a winner at Maryborough on October 12. SELECTIONS: SURETHING (7), ROCKAMARA (8), BUBBLE OVER (9), PHILS BOY (5)

ULTIMATE GLADIATOR (4) flashed home late when narrowly beaten last start at Burnie. His form has been hit and miss since arriving in the state, but at his best, he looks one of the clear fancies here. CONSORT NZ (5) arrives from New South Wales, and you would expect that form to stand up in a field like this. He also looked to have something in reserve in a recent trial at Carrick. SPORT WATCHER (6) is consistent in this grade and looks next best, along with SPORTZSILK (2), who, if he brings his best behaviour and is able to find the front, could take some running down at odds. DANCINWIVJOLENE (3) could run into the placings, as can BARBETTE (7) with the right run in transit and some tempo on throughout. Selections:ULTIMATE GLADIATOR (4), CONSORT NZ (5), SPORT WATCHER (6), SPORTZSILK (2) Staking Strategy:CONSORT should get his chance to run over the top of them here first up in the state. 2 unit win – CONSORT (5).

An extremely even field combines with a somewhat tricky speed map, but expect IDEN LADY LINCOLN (3) to push forward from her draw and look to find the front, where she may take some running down after three solid efforts since resuming from a long break. MERRYWOOD PAUL (4) continues to threaten to break through for his first win in the state and, despite drawing an awkward gate, can't be dismissed. MOVESLIKEALADY (9) should appreciate the smaller field and, with any tempo during the running, could take some holding out late. At his best, BAIL DENIED (2) could easily win a race like this from the nice draw. KARALTA ARTEMIS (7) again draws the outside gate for the fourth time in a row and will be relying on tempo throughout, while IDEN OLIVER (8) is going better than his past few runs suggest and could be a chance at odds if she gets clear running late. Selections:IDEN LADY LINCOLN (3), BAIL DENIED (2), MOVESLIKEALADY (9), MERRYWOOD PAUL (4) Staking Strategy:IDEN LADY LINCOLN is a good chance of finding the top here, where she will be hard to run down. 2 unit win – IDEN LADY LINCOLN (3).

The $20,000 Fillies Championship is another tricky speed-map race to assess. TWILIGHT STORM (8) was a strong winner in fast time last start when able to get her own way in front, and although she draws as the lone back-row runner here, her class could prevail. QUEEN ANASTASIA (5) was somewhat back to her handy two-year-old form when resuming last start, despite doing the work outside the leader. If she holds that form, she looks the testing material for the favourite. STAYZBETTER (1) resumes from a long break but was more than handy in her two-year-old races last season. Her trial during the week looked as though she is back on track, and if anywhere near her best, she could take some beating from the ideal pole draw. A ROCKN NIGHTMARE (2) and SWEETHEART DIOR (4) have been consistent since arriving in the state and you would expect both to push forward from their draws, while JILLSTIGER (4), SUMTHIN ELSE (6) and QUETZALLI (7) will be relying on some solid tempo throughout to allow them to get into the finish. It wouldn't surprise to see any of them bob up and win in an even race. Selections:TWILIGHT STORM (8), QUEEN ANASTASIA (5), STAYZBETTER (1), SWEETHEAT DIOR (3) Staking Strategy: Happy to back QUEEN ANASTASIA at the better odds here over the favourite. 2 unit win – QUEEN ANASTASIA (5).

The boys' division for the three-year-olds, where PORT RUN MACHINE will look to continue on his winning ways after two very impressive performances at his past two starts. He should be off the pegs early and into the running line, where driver Gareth Rattray will have options whether to put him into the race or come with one run, but either way he should be extremely hard to beat. ROCKY STRIDE (7) is a super-consistent pacer who has been racing against older horses and should appreciate getting back to his own age here. While the draw does hurt his chances, he looks the clear danger to the favourite. IYLAC CHAMBER (2) should appreciate the better draw and may attempt to find the pegs, where he could run into the placings. TAPPY (6) will be relying on some tempo throughout to allow him to run home strongly, as he usually does. WHERE IT BEGAN (1) was a trial black booker on Monday night, recording a quick last half, and could run a race at odds if he brings his best behaviour. WINNING BREW (3) and HIGH BELIEVER (4) have been in good form but face somewhat of a class rise here and will be looking to run into the placings with some luck in running. Selections:PORT RUN MACHINE (8), ROCKY STRIDE (7), TAPPY (6), IYLAC CHAMBER (2) Staking Strategy:PORT RUN MACHINE should show his class and be too strong. 5 unit win – PORT RUN MACHINE (8).

OUR NAKED ART (5) couldn't have done much more first up in the state when doing work early and running second in very fast time in the open mares race. She draws a very awkward gate here for a horse who lacks any real gate speed, but her class can't be ruled out. MUZZAME MATE (4) continues to run good races without winning and may push forward looking to benefit from some cover in running. REMMINGTON (2) has been racing well and, although rising sharply in class here, can't be ruled out from the nice draw. SNOWIEWILLREV (1) and JOHN VINCENT (3) will look to take advantage of their good front-row draws to find spots on speed and give themselves their best chances. PREPARATION (10) got the gap when he needed it first up when saluting last start and will appreciate any tempo throughout to allow him to run home strongly, as will ATOMIC BLACK (12), with those two looking the best of the back-row runners. Selections:OUR NAKED ART (5), MUZZAME MATE (4), PREPARATION (10), ATOMIC BLACK (12) Staking Strategy:MUZZAME MATE should sit on speed with cover and get his chance here in the even field. 1 unit win – MUZZAME MATE (4).

A rare full field combines for the Group 2 two-year-old fillies, where DANGER BEWARE (10) looked ultra-impressive on debut after copping interference in the running but still proving too fast late in her heat. She will be relying somewhat on a solid tempo throughout from her back-row draw, which I would expect to come from stablemate KOOKY (5), who will be pushing hard from her middle front-row gate in an attempt to find the front again, as she did in her heat win. She looked to be waiting for them after putting a gap on the field around the home turn before others interfered with her momentum, and clearly looks the testing material if she brings her best form. VINJETTA (2) is somehow still a maiden after putting together some top performances in the recent features and was narrowly run down late after doing all the work in the run last start. She gets the perfect draw here to sit on speed and gets her chance to finally break through. ELEANOR STREET (1) looked to be travelling well before breaking at the 500-metre mark in her heat when a short-priced favourite. She has since trialled well and will be looking to take advantage of the pole draw, most likely attempting to hold out FARRAHS LEGACY (3), who showed sharp gate speed last start before surrendering the lead and was another interfered with on the home turn. It wouldn't surprise to see her run a bold race at odds if she was able to be first to the pegs here. MON BELLE AMOUR (4) is another who was interfered with in that race and looks an improving type, while RAZZAMATAZ (6) looks the other winning chance but will need some luck from her awkward front-row draw to get into the finish. Selections:DANGER BEWARE (10), KOOKY (5), VINJETTA (2), ELEANOR STREET (1) Staking Strategy:DANGER BEWARE was clearly the standout run of the heats and, with good tempo expected early, will be running home strongly, with a saver on VINJETTA (2), who appears overs. 3 unit win – DANGER BEWARE (10). 1 unit win – VINJETTA (2).

The draw has really opened up the boys' division of the two-year-old Tasbreds, where POGACAR (4) draws the best of the fancied runners. Expect him to push forward and find a spot on speed, which should make him hard to hold out late. MYSTERY MAIL (5), STABLE TALK (6) and BUILTTHEMANASTATUE (7) all have good gate speed when asked, and you would expect all three to come out looking to find positions on speed to give themselves their best chances. MYSTERY MAIL (5) was clearly the blackbooker of the heats at odds when running home sharply from back in the field to finish second to the standout two-year-old of the season, BETTOR THAN READY (8), who will need plenty of luck from his inside back-row draw, where his chance may rely on if OUR ROBS ROY (1) holds the front. CALZO SNIPER (9) should get a nice run through from his trailing back-row draw, while FARROH JOE (11) has put together two strong performances since arriving in the state and should be running home strongly. With any genuine tempo throughout, he could be hard to hold out late. Selections: FARROH JOE (11), MYSTERY MAIL (5), BETTOR THAN READY (8), POGACAR (4) Staking Strategy:MYSTERY MAIL and FARROH JOE both look like fair each-way bets here. 1 unit each-way – MYSTERY MAIL (5) and FARROH JOE (11).

ANN PENNY (1) takes on the older horses here but looked very sharp when showing brilliant gate speed last week and winning comfortably. Expect she gets her chance to lead all the way, with not a whole lot of gate speed amongst the other front-row runners outside of KUHIO CREST (3), who should push forward from his handy draw and has put together a couple of good performances of late in this sort of grade. REALLY SMARTIE (2) should get a perfect run from barrier two throughout and gets his chance to be in the finish, while SPOOKY GIRL (8), at her best, could be the one at odds from the nice back-row draw trailing the expected short-priced favourite. KENYA (12) can never be ruled out in these sorts of races, but his task is made harder from outside the back row over the short distance when he usually likes to be put into the race. QUEENOFDANCE (10) will be relying on some genuine tempo throughout to allow them to run home strongly into the placings. Selections:ANN PENNY (1), REALLY SMARTIE (2), SPOOKY GIRL (8), KUHIO CREST (3) Staking Strategy:ANN PENNY takes on the older horses, but she’ll get her chance for an all-the-way victory over the mile again. 3 unit win – ANN PENNY (1).

HORATIUS SPECULO (3) will look to continue on his winning ways after another strong performance in good time when coming off the 20 metres last start. Whether he has to do the work outside the leader or finds the top, expect his class to prevail if he holds that form. WAVES OF CHANCE (2) has been super consistent of late and gets the draw to again find a nice spot on speed, where he will be looking to cross the pole marker in EVERYTHING BUT THE (1). He has really found his best form of late, winning three of his past four, but steps up into Free For All grade for the first time here. GO THE RED (4) will again look to be running home strongly to get into the placings, while STEPPING STONES (7) was very good first up from a break last week against the mares when leading them up three wide in a very slick time. Her chances could be tempo dependent here. Selections:HORATIUS SPECULO (3), WAVES OF CHANCE (2), STEPPING STONES (7), EVERYTHING BUT THE (1) Staking Strategy:HORATIUS SPECULO looks almighty hard to beat, but as expected, there’s not much value there. We’ll play the exacta with WAVES OF CHANCE. 2 unit exacta – HORATIUS SPECULO (3) to beat WAVES OF CHANCE (2).

James Herbertson is an important driver booking to get the best out of him with an ideal draw and map. That may suit NEW SHUFFLE (9), who is a sit-and-sprint type who excels when coming with one run off a fast tempo. He's well in with the concession claim and comes off a brief freshen-up following an excellent 4th in the Geelong Cup, where he found the line strongly. His overall record is very strong for a race of this nature. SEATHESTARS (3) looked like he was getting back to his best in his victory last week when he was able to lead all the way. It's uncertain how the map works out this time, but I'm happy to have him in the numbers, as his best is good enough. FAIRPLAY (7) is racing well this season, with five wins from six starts, but has drawn to map better on those occasions. He has talent, so despite a few things needing to work out, he can't be dismissed. SCHWARZ (2) had to work too hard last time, but from a better marble could get a nicer trip depending on tactics. JACCKA EVAN (6) won that race but is likely to go back, while stablemates BLAKE BOLAC (5) and ALWAYS BE BLAKEY (8) will need a lot to go their way but are racing well. BACK: NEW SHUFFLE (9) – 3 units (win) SELECTIONS:NEW SHUFFLE (9), SEATHESTARS (3), FAIRPLAY (7), SCHWARZ (2)

OVERVIEW:ENJOY LIFE (9) is a high-quality 3yo who comes through the A-grade form lines, including the Derby last start, where he travelled keenly behind the leader, who fell back into his lap, costing him all momentum before finishing not far away in 6th. His form prior was first-rate, albeit from better draws where he was able to dictate. He won't have that luxury now but can deliver a high-speed finish to overcome them. SEASIDE BOY (4) gets a better draw and actually beat home the top pick in the Derby, where he had to go back and worked home well. From this more favourable marble, expect a more aggressive drive, and he could prove hard to run down, particularly if he finds the lead. DECODE (2) will have something to say about the speed map and has been terrific this season. He's unfortunate not to have a better record, having faced some bad draws in major races. He was okay in the Derby, but with the others outperforming him there, that dampens confidence slightly. MOST EXCITING (8) has mixed his form a little this season, but more often that's been because of taking on the elite 3yos. He can only be driven for luck from this draw but will be strong late if the gaps come. There's not a runner who would surprise at the minor end for exotics. BACK: ENJOY LIFE (9) – 3 units (win) SELECTIONS:ENJOY LIFE (9), SEASIDE BOY (4), DECODE (2), MOST EXCITING (8)

OVERVIEW:BULLETPROOF BOY (8) comes out of the Victoria Cup, where he had every chance and was fair in finishing 5th. Prior to that, he was terrific in winning the Smoken Up Sprint, but that was over his preferred distance. Even if he may not be at his elite best this preparation, he does bring the A-grade form to be the testing material at this level of FFA. JILLIBY NITRO (6) was terrific in winning the Geelong Cup two starts back at only his second run from a break. He then had a terrible draw and set-up in the Victoria Cup, so forget he went around. He has the tactical advantage of the three topliners here and has the versatility to command respect. CATCH A WAVE (7) may be obliged to press forward here, as he has done from the same draw recently, winning on one of those occasions, albeit over the shorter trip. He's going okay, and as an eight-time G1 winner, he can never be dismissed. SIR JIMMY (3) needs to come with one run, and he probably hasn't had much luck getting things to work out of late. He will enjoy this level of FFA, though, and is in the mix. COASTAL DRIVE (1) has been racing well and will look to use the draw to his advantage. It's just whether he's up to these over the trip. SELECTIONS:BULLETPROOF BOY (8), JILLIBY NITRO (6), CATCH A WAVE (7), SIR JIMMY (3)

OVERVIEW: The scratching of Twigstar has really changed the complexion of this race, as she would have led with the opposition happy to sit off her speed. Now it creates a bit of uncertainty with the map, and the major rival CATCH THE CAPTAIN (9) may be forced to put himself in the race from the back row. He was good on debut, so whilst the set-up looks a little different for him this time, he’s worth sticking with. FARADAY (5) did what she had to do winning on debut and wasn't breathtaking in that victory as a $1.18 favourite in a small field. She is from the top stable, however, so you can only expect improvement from that effort. DREAMS FOREVER (2) hasn't been the punters' pal, going down as a short-priced favourite in her last two, but did show ability in some earlier performances, while OZZIE TART (1) can use her speed to get a nice map and looks the other major player at the minor end. SELECTIONS:CATCH THE CAPTAIN (9), FARADAY (5), DREAMS FOREVER (2), OZZIE TART (1)

OVERVIEW:SEA FURY (9) was flying earlier in the year, but his last few runs haven't been up to that standard, at least numerically, as you could make a few small excuses. This is the most winnable race he's been in for a while, and the tick-over trial was good enough to suggest he's on track. He can bounce back against these. IM DOWNBYTHESEASIDE (6) was a good winner when able to lead from the same draw last campaign and looked to be progressing well, getting up in class quickly. This race looks much more suitable than his first-up assignment, and with added fitness, he will be hard to beat. WHERE IS WOODY (7) switches to one of Victoria's leading stables, and while the draw is no luxury, he's normally a one-run type, so may drift back and, with the right tempo, finish well. POPCORNFRIDAY (1) and BRINGUSJOY (2) would look for the lead but would need little pressure thereafter, while FIRE MARSHALL (8) is dependent on how that all works out in front of him. They're all worth keeping safe. BACK: SEA FURY (9) – 2 units (win) SELECTIONS:SEA FURY (9), IM DOWNBYTHESEASIDE (6), WHERE IS WOODY (7), POPCORNFRIDAY (1)

OVERVIEW:LOWRIDER (6) is the testing material here from the leading stable, coming out of stronger 3yo races, albeit safely held in those. He failed when taking on the older horses five runs back, but that seemed harder than what he faces here. He's likely to start very short odds on a few key indicators, but to the eye, he's not the most reliable type, so tread warily. BULLETPROOF KID (5) is a fast beginner who finds a much more suitable race than what he's been facing recently. His numerical form disguises his ability, and he can give cheek in this if he's able to get the right trip. SRIRACHA (2) can begin well enough from the draw to take up a handy position here, and although he's up in class, he may have more ability than most. His one win here came as a 2yo. POSTERIZED (9) will have to be driven for luck from this draw, but if he happens to get a soft run and favourable sectionals to close, he'll be doing his best work late. OWEN THE SAINTS (8) seems the other main hope for the exotics but is yet to place from six attempts here. SELECTIONS:LOWRIDER (6), BULLETPROOF KID (5), SRIRACHA (2), POSTERIZED (9)

BESTINBEDS.COM.AU PACE PALLADIUM (4) was a beaten favourite in the Victoria Derby last start but he did have to work so was far from disgraced when just over 4m from the winner. Impressive winner of his Derby heat prior and produced two strong efforts here last month including an easy win from a much wider draw. The drop to the mile is some query but he has the speed to go forward from this draw. NEPTUNITE (2) did a great job to come from much wider and score by 3 metres over this distance at his first visit to this circuit last start. Tackles some good opposition here but his strike rate is impressive and a low draw helps. WICKED CONFESSION (1) comes off a placing from a much wider barrier in the Ladyship Cup last start at Melton. Tackles the boys this time but is well served by the ace draw. A wide barrier presents a challenge to last-start winner I GOT CHILLS (11) but his form is hard to knock. His stablemate HUXTON (8) is also good enough to feature with some luck on his side.

NUTRIEN EQUINE NSW BREEDERS CHALLENGE 4YO ENTIRES AND GELDINGS FINAL (GROUP 3) DOUBLE LOU (1) was a beaten favourite last week but it was his first outing for three-and-a-half months and he worked from a wide barrier so the effort to box on for a 1.5m second had plenty of merit. Owns a strong second-up record so will be improved and won the 3CG final of this series last year. He looks much better served by the ace draw. FOREVER ONTHE PUNT (2) has been terrific in winning all three starts at this circuit since joining Brad Hewitt for this campaign. Came from this barrier when he scored over this distance last week. Could add to the winning streak. WICKED WIZARD (4) took his record at this circuit and distance to three from four when beating Double Lou last week. He draws to play a role again. JUNGLE DRAGON (6) hasn't been far from the placegetters of late and his best form would measure right up. SINALOA (5) improved to place last week and is a two-time third-up winner so could progress further aided by a good draw.

NUTRIEN EQUINE NSW BREEDERS CHALLENGE 4YO MARES FINAL (GROUP 3) GUNNA RELOAD (2) won the three-year-old fillies final of this series last year and looks to be in form at the right time again, leading from wider when scoring by 3.2m last week. That took her strike rate at this circuit and distance to 50 per cent and she has recorded three wins and a placing from four third up attempts so should be peaking. Can go forward again from the low draw and looks tough to catch. SMIRKIN SERENE (4) dug deep for a second-up win last week, adding to a handy record at this circuit and distance. Draws wider but has won two of three previous second-up attempts so can be in the finish again. SUGAR PIE HONEY (11) was a beaten favourite when 3m off Smirkin Serene last week but that was her first outing for more than three months and it should have improved her. A wide draw hurts but she won a final of this series at two so has talent and strikes at 50 per cent second up. OUR SPECIAL MEMORY (3) was just behind Smirkin Serene last week and draws to be competitive.

CLUB MENANGLE BATTLE OF BEERSHEBA FFA (LISTED CLASSIC) SWAYZEE (11) called on his trademark courage to return to the winners' list here last week, racing parked before getting home by 1.6m. Has won five of eight tries at this longer distance so it should suit him better and he strikes at 50 per cent when third-up so should be further improved. He can overcome the outside barrier to deliver again. ROYAL CRUISER (9) was last seen when second in the Breeders Challenge 4EG Final a year ago and won twice in a row here prior so he is a talent. Draws wide but was readied with a solid trial and is a two-time fresh winner. RIPP (10) did a good job to come from this barrier and place behind Swayzee last week. He is a trifecta player again. ITS CONFIDENTIAL (2) draws much better than last week and is two from two at this longer distance so could be an improver.

NUTRIEN EQUINE NSW BREEDERS CHALLENGE 3YO FILLIES FINAL (GROUP 1) ARK SEA (6) set a new record time for fillies when leading and dominating her semi-final last week, her third win from as many starts this time in. That win added to a strong record at this circuit and distance and should have topped her off for this. She draws closer to the pegs and has the speed to take advantage of that so is the one to beat. Queensland visitor STRIPES (7) has been impossible to knock in putting five wins together, the last two coming in a heat and semi of this series, both at this circuit and distance. Would've helped her to have drawn inside Ark Sea but she is in terrific form. ONE MORE REASON (9) is a consistent filly who came from this barrier for second to Ark Sea last week and won from a similar draw prior. She can be in the finish along with EYE WISH (10) who draws wide but kept giving behind Stripes last week and won two in a row prior. FAKE FRIENDS (2) has been going okay from wider barriers so could be upset material from the low draw.

NUTRIEN EQUINE NSW BREEDERS CHALLENGE 3YO COLTS AND GELDINGS FINAL (GROUP 1) Boom colt LOUCASSO (10) set an Australasian record for his age with a stunning win last week, stretching his winning streak to seven and taking his perfect record at this circuit and distance to four. Draws out and has some talented three-year-olds inside him so this will be more of challenge but he has the brilliance to overcome the barrier. NSW Derby placegetter YOTTIE (5) made it three from three this time in with a fighting win last week. Has the speed to take advantage of this draw. That should give him his chance. NOCTURNAL (6) did a great job to finish just over 2m off Loucasso last week given the scorching time. He has really developed some consistency, as has ALERT BAY (9) who was good again after working last week and won well prior. Both of those of colts have been competitive with Loucasso of late and could push him again. COHEN THE RED (1) hasn't been far away in two outings for Luke McCarthy and draws the inside so is worth including.

NUTRIEN EQUINE NSW BREEDERS CHALLENGE 2YO FILLIES FINAL (GROUP 1) Looks a battle between the two fillies that have been racking up the wins but the draw has given the advantage to the Victorian COMEANDSEE (3). She has dominated in both rounds of this series, the latest when she led and cruised home by 5.5m in her semi-final at this circuit and distance. Expect her to push forward again from this barrier and if she gets her way up front she'll be hard to catch. BIRDSONG (10) draws wide but she is already a Group 1 winner and is three from three at this circuit and distance this time in. Should be peaking for this and has won from similar barriers before. She could do it again. FRITH IN FLIGHT (7) is a progressive filly who won well here two back then raced parked and stuck on okay behind Birdsong last start. She is a trifecta hope as is SHES A DELANEY (11) who cops a wide draw but has the speed to go forward from out there and has been very consistent with a string of wins and placings to her name.

NUTRIEN EQUINE NSW BREEDERS CHALLENGE 2YO COLTS AND GELDINGS FINAL (GROUP 1) DON HUNTER (6) has enjoyed the ideal lead-up to this race, winning his two starts off a spell in good style. Led and was too good in scoring by more than 5m last start, stretching his perfect record at this circuit and distance to five. Should be hitting his peak for finals night and looks the one to beat. DISTURBANCE (9) just keeps improving and made it three wins on the trot when he dug deep to win his semi-final last start. Draws wider but his form is strong enough to see him in the finish again. BOYSTROUS (4) led and fought well when edged out by Disturbance last time and had a good winning strike rate prior. He can give a sight from this draw. TUAPEKA GOLD (3) has come from wider draws in each start of this campaign and managed to win a heat of this series here two back. He is a first four hope from the good draw. SLIP SLIDNAWAY (10) draws wide but has made a decent start to his career and is worth including.

HRNSW RISING STARS (PENALTY EXEMPT EVENT) There was plenty to like about last week's performance of OHOKA COBRA (1) when he came from a wider barrier to place. He is much better served by this barrier having led from there to win over this distance two back at Newcastle. He could do that again. JILLIBY FABIO (4) worked to the front from one spot wider than this and kept going to score by 5.5m at this circuit and distance last start. This looks another suitable assignment so he could back that up. Manners have let ROCKNROLL COWBOY (2) down in his two outings since he kicked off his campaign with two wins at this circuit and distance. Has won a trial since the last appearance and draws well. He is good enough to win if he gets it right. AGATHA BLOOM (12) may need luck from the outside draw but is going well with wins in three of her last five outings, one of them from this barrier. VAN BASTEN (6) hasn't been far away of late and draws lower than last time.

CLUB MENANGLE TONY AND JILL MCGRATH TROTTERS MOBILE (LISTED CLASSIC) CORMORAN STRIKE (12) broke when tackling the Bill Collins Sprint at Melton last start but is much better suited returning to this venue having put together a string of top-two results here prior. Draws out but he is building a strong record at the mile and is good enough to overcome the barrier. TORO STRIDE (4) is another coming through the Bill Collins Sprint where he copped a tough barrier. Good effort to place when resuming from a wide barrier here prior and ended his last campaign with a placing in the Inter Dominion Final. Has a class drop and a better draw in his favour. ZENITH STRIDE (9) scored by 3m over this distance last start, his second success from four starts here since a long layoff. Both of those wins were from this barrier. Each way hope. YOUR MAJESTY (6) is a two-time fresh winner readied with a solid trial. Expect a strong return from her. BEST BETS:
#2 Gunna Reload – In form at the right time and well served by this draw.
